authored_by: quant-methodology specialist (native Codex; independent of implementation)
scope: Bounded CP6 deterministic rules; ACTUAL only; no new financial computation or human approval

shared.comparisons: Exact upstream Fraction or signed square-root witness; never rounded metric.value. Unsupported exact ordering is refused.
shared.insufficient_data: No surfaced numeric claim; typed diagnostic only.
shared.limited: Value retained with complete caveats; no WARNING. UNKNOWN/LIMITED freshness or temporal comparability caps personal-policy breach at ATTENTION.
shared.integrity: Upstream reproduction and canonical complete result equality; refs and immutable Proof Packet bind dependencies and claim.
shared.no_generic_severity: No generic Attention/Warning or invented personal threshold; denominator policy is not a risk preference.

entries.predicate: Verified scalar CP4/CP5 value exists; state AVAILABLE or LIMITED.
entries.minimum_dependencies: One verified supported metric and its exact upstream snapshot context.
entries.limitations: No good/bad, overall diversification, largest-sector or risk-tolerance conclusion. LIMITED caveats retained; count is only a fact.

entries.predicate: Verified supported exact active_return < 0 with an explicit dated primary-benchmark reference.
entries.minimum_dependencies: One supported relative-return metric plus verified benchmark selection/identity and declared historical window.
entries.boundary: Exact zero/positive do not trigger; rounded zero with negative exact witness does trigger with rounding caveat.
entries.limitations: LIMITED sufficiency/comparability remain explicit; no severity escalation or automatic SPY default.

entries.predicate: Two verified supported compatible metrics; baseline.as_of < current.as_of; exact values differ.
entries.minimum_dependencies: Two same-portfolio/scope/metric/subject semantic matches preserving each window/state/count/limitations.
entries.boundary: Exact equality does not trigger; exact difference behind equal display triggers only with rounding caveat.
entries.limitations: Direction only; no invented delta value, significance threshold, forecast, model-to-actual substitution or desirability claim.

entries.predicate: One valid effective USER_CONFIRMED exact-scope selector policy; MAXIMUM x>L or MINIMUM x<L using exact witness.
entries.minimum_dependencies: One verified supported metric and exactly one applicable immutable explicit personal policy.
entries.boundary: Equality is not a breach; effective dates inclusive; signed maximum drawdown compared literally.
entries.policy_precedence: Matching explicit policy determines judgment; no generic heuristic or global-product denominator substitutes. Exact scope only; no account/portfolio inheritance. Distinct overlapping selectors conflict.
entries.limitations: No trigger is not a safety/suitability conclusion. No thresholds supplied by this registry.
